sentences.text: It was agreed that a sum of Rs.7,00,000/- as full and final settlement shall be paid by petitioner No. 1 to respondent No. 2.
Out of the settlement amount, the balance amount of Rs.2,00,000/- is being paid today through a demand draft, a photocopy of which has been placed on record.
5. Petitioners and respondent No.2, who are present in Court, have been identified by their respective counsel as well as by I.O./SI Sanjay Tomar, P.S. Karawal Nagar.

6. Respondent No. 2 states that she has settled her disputes with the petitioners of her own free will,
volition and without any coercion.
She submits that she has no objection in case the FIR is quashed against the petitioners subject to encashment of the demand draft of Rs.2,00,000/- handed over to her today.
7. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that no other proceedings are pending between the parties.
